name: Onna Kishi Sofia vs Nikuyoku no Orc ~Chijoku no Ishukan Tougijou~
original_name: 女騎士ソフィアvs肉欲のオーク～恥辱の異種姦闘技場～
source:
Sophia battled monsters heroically to save her prince, but underestimates her final enemy: an Orc with a massive special gift. Now the poison of the lovebeast will seep into her pleasured body. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE045282.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
索菲亚英勇战斗拯救王子，却低估了最后敌人：拥有巨大特殊礼物的兽人。如今，爱兽的毒素将渗入她享受快感的身体。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE045282.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
